truths.truth: A diverged session's ingest pass opens its transcript exactly once
truths.evidence: crates/terminus-core/src/ingest/mod.rs:1002 read_flagged does the length check (open_at_least, :1084), prefix_matches on the same handle, then rest_of; the unflagged path keeps read_tail. The only open on the ingest path is discover::open_transcript (grep finds no other File::open of a transcript in terminus-core/src). Tests a_flagged_session_opens_its_transcript_once_per_pass and a_flagged_session_rewritten_under_its_watermark_opens_it_once (tests/compaction.rs) passed in the suite run, asserting one new open-log entry per pass.

truths.evidence: schema.rs:213,221 declares both columns last; schema.rs:484 appends the decisions entry to BRING_FORWARD_COLUMNS; feedback/mod.rs:270 insert writes i64::from(decision.compacted) and document(&decision.dropped). The value enters at prompt.rs:384-385 (decision.compacted/dropped set under the compacted pool). Test a_drained_decision_keeps_its_compaction saves records through Decision::save and reads back (1, "[41,42]") and (0, "[]"); a_store_without_the_compaction_columns_gains_them_and_its_rows_read_unknown passed. truths.truth: terminus stats counts compacted and ordinary decisions apart in --json and human output, and the docs describe the two keys
truths.evidence: feedback/stats.rs adds compacted_decisions/ordinary_decisions; cmd/stats.rs adds the two fields after decisions in the Document and the indented '  compacted'/'  ordinary' lines. (Serialized keys come out alphabetical, as every existing key already does.) docs/json-shapes.md stats example and bullet, docs/commands.md stats paragraph, and DATA_COMMANDS in tests/cli.rs carry both; cli stats test passed.

truths.truth: For a decision with compacted = 1, changing --compacted-ranked changes replay's result; 0 and null decisions replay through the ordinary window
truths.evidence: feedback/replay.rs: eligible selects dropped only when compacted = 1; would_inject limits by compacted_ranked when dropped is Some and filters with prompt::within after eligible, before capped. Core test a_compacted_decision_replays_through_the_compacted_pool asserts kinds [1,0,null], shipped thresholds change nothing, and compacted_ranked 0 changes only the compacted decision (diff.changed == [compacted]). CLI test compacted_ranked_moves_a_compacted_decision passed. Both in the suite run.

truths.truth: stats and replay answer on a store without the new columns, treat the values as unknown, and do not alter the store
truths.evidence: Both commands go through cmd/read.rs open_in -> Store::open_read_only; stats checks missing_columns for decisions.compacted, replay selects NULL when any decisions column is missing. truths.evidence: feedback/mod.rs:45 ABANDONED_AFTER = 10 min; :209 sweep matches decision/state TEMPORARY_PREFIX/SUFFIX, uses symlink_metadata and is_file, reports nothing; :157 drain calls it before the empty-found return. truths.truth: A system/compact_boundary record with no uuid or timestamp gets a compactions row at its byte offset, later turns keep their ids, and the next prompt treats the turns before it as dropped
truths.evidence: derive.rs:194 derive_boundary (skips turns and non-system subtypes) is called from ingest apply (ingest/mod.rs:540, same transaction) and reindex (reindex.rs:217); inject/compaction.rs orders by stream_offset and takes turns with lower stream_offset. truths.truth: A DERIVED_SCHEMA 4 store is rebuilt to 5 on first open, with or without evicted sessions, ending with compactions in place of compaction_boundaries
truths.evidence: open.rs:58 DERIVED_SCHEMA = 5; reindex.rs:135 retire_old_boundaries runs before any drop or clear, copying evicted sessions' rows when preserving (:276); every pass reaches it through recover::recover -> reindex::open_up_to_date (ingest/pass.rs:262). truths.truth: Comments this phase wrote, or left describing behaviour it changed, are accurate (D-18)
truths.evidence: crates/terminus/src/cmd/hook.rs:239-241, written this phase, says a cut-off write 'leaves at most a `.tmp`'. But decision.rs:323-351 writes the .tmp, reserves the target .json with create_new, drops it, then renames, so a kill between the reservation and the rename leaves the .tmp and an empty .json. The drain keeps that .json for ten minutes, then deletes it and records 'not a decision record this build can read' in runs.error (seen in the spot-check for truth 10). Also stale, and listed by SUMMARY as open items: parse/record.rs:103-110 (is_compact_boundary says a boundary is already a turn because it carries uuid and timestamp, which is no longer true of every boundary after #17) and tests/inject_state.rs:267 ('the injection scratch is quoted prompt text').
